TEXT:
[FI] After playing around on the beach for a while, 
Ayase and I were pacing Atami's shopping district. 
Of course, we walked around holding hands.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Today has been so much fun already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I feel the same. I'll definitely be able to sleep well 
tonight.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eheh, I suppose.

[FI] We had both long forgotten the nervousness we 
had felt when we first arrived here.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, I wonder what that is.

[FI] Something caught her attention outside one of the 
shops and she dragged me over. It's actually kind 
of nice being dragged around like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] There sure are a lot of different kinds of Japanese 
confectionery...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You like that kind of stuff?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Yes! Oh, that's right. Shouldn't we buy some 
souvenirs while we're here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I guess so...

SPEAKER: SPK_CLERK
TEXT: [FI] Welcome!

[FI] As we were looking through the various kinds of 
Japanese confectionery, the clerk called out to us.

SPEAKER: SPK_CLERK
TEXT:
[FI] Walking around hand in hand, you two sure are 
close.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_CLERK
TEXT: [FI] Are you siblings?

[FI] Hearing the clerk's words, Ayase suddenly hugged 
onto my arm.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey, Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] W-What is it? We always do this, right, Onii--... 
Kyousuke-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_CLERK
TEXT: [FI] Oh, I'm sorry.

[FI] Seeing us, the clerk's expression changed into a 
teasing smile as she retreated into the shop.

[FI] Confirming that she was out of sight, Ayase 
hurriedly let go of my arm and instead grabbed 
my hand again.

[FI] I guess it's still too early for her to be flirting 
openly.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Let's go, Onii-san... Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah...
[FI] My mind had wandered somewhere else.

[FI] I mean, she just called me by name. That means 
we're moving forward, doesn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Wait. Didn't we pass by here earlier?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, I don't think we did, but...

[FI] We were completely lost. Well, we're in a town we 
haven't been to before, so it's not all that strange, I 
guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Hmm, we should try finding the station at least, 
don't you think?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] H-Huh? How strange...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Anyway, let's head towards the main street and see 
where that leads us.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, I suppose.

[FI] I urged Ayase on as she looked rather concerned, 
but... There's nobody around here, so maybe I could 
try putting my arm around her waist?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san, is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, no, it's nothing.

[FI] No, no. Doing that in Odaiba already gave me quite 
a painful experience... But we've got a really good 
mood going on, so maybe?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Alright.

[FI] I made up my mind, I will put my arm around her 
waist! What if she kicks me? I'll worry about it 
when that happens!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah...

[FI] Ayase noticed my arm moving and stiffened up. Ah, 
no good?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Geez, Onii-san, you're so hopeless.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Uh, do you mind?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Well, like this, nobody would doubt that we're a 
pair of lovers.

[FI] Ayase-san, you're still worried about that incident 
earlier? But, to let others see this...

[FI] Then again, I guess she's more relaxed now than 
that time in Odaiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, it seems like we're back on the main street.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] L-Looks like it...

[FI] As we returned to the main street, I bashfully 
retracted my arm and raised my eyes.
[FI] That was when a single raindrop fell onto my face.
